Evidence sources and limits

Answer counts and the timeline use your selected period. The current evidence stage and review date use all saved evidence, under the local demo policy. Completion, self-reported confidence and saved drafts do not measure knowledge.

Guided learning and earlier journeys keep separate evidence identities. Multiple versions of the same guided objective are grouped; open each activity to review its original source. No evidence is transferred between source versions.

Unverified work and application records are excluded from answer accuracy. A saved application is work recorded, not an independent assessment.
